purpose: Test whether market-independent structural layers create a long-term, fixed-stake Wide betting edge after market calibration, with profitability rather than probability metrics as the final gate.

data.scope: JRA flat, field_size >= 12, 3-win class or higher, exactly three Top3 labels
data.wide_return_proxy: final Wide lower odds; conservative proxy, not exact payout and not T-15 executable odds

protocol.runner_model_walkforward: For test year Y, Ability and reconstructed M3 are refit only on years strictly earlier than Y.
protocol.m3_alpha_selection: Ridge alpha selected before the test window using 2017 train -> 2018 validation only.
protocol.pair_probability_walkforward: 2019 supplies the first pair calibration history; pair outcome models are tested on 2020-2026 with only prior-year pair rows.
protocol.bet_rule: At most one Wide pair per race: select the highest predicted EV pair, fixed 1u stake, and require the stated EV threshold.

models.market: wide lower odds + odds-range ratio + field size
models.market_plus_ability_plus_m3: market + Ability + walk-forward reconstructed M3 pair features
models.queue_proxy: market + Ability + M3 + strictly prior frontness summary pair features. This is NOT the current Production P10/ValidatedQueue model.

ev_threshold_1_05.note: The superficially profitable result disappears completely after removing the largest winning payout. Bets are concentrated in the early test period rather than stable across years.

decision.reason: Neither layer meets the long-term profitability standard. M3 profitability is dominated by a single payout. The frontness/Queue proxy has pooled ROI >100 but fails after removing the top two payouts and has extreme drawdown, extreme losing streaks, zero-return years, and vanishing bet counts in recent years.
decision.anti_champion_policy: Do not tune EV thresholds, odds caps, or feature cuts on 2020-2026 until a new pre-specified hypothesis is defined. A rule is not promoted merely because pooled ROI exceeds 100%.
decision.next_test: Evaluate the already-existing frozen WIDE SIGNAL selection logic as a rule family, rather than searching arbitrary thresholds. Keep current P10/Queue validation separate from the frontness proxy because the proxy is not the Production model.
